messages:
Elena: heads up — uploaded panelist onboarding + timed deck template. Need timers and video cue decisions by EOD tomorrow. Link: https://drive.re/redwood/panelist-onboard
Samir: got it. Do we want 60s per demo slide or 90s? Last webinar ran long.
Jordan: +1 on shorter. Recommend 45s for TL;DR slides, 2 min for demo.
Priya: can we put explicit cue cards in speaker notes? That's what helped last time.
Samir: agree. I'll add speaker prompts and a visible timer in the slides. Example snippet:
```
# timer layer (pseudo)
slide_timer = 45  # seconds per slide
start_timer(slide_timer)
```
Elena: nice. Also need stage ops cues: when to switch camera, when to queue live demo, and fallback text for infra hiccups.
Jordan: propose these cues:
- `camera_on` at 00:15 of slide 1
- `demo_start` at 00:20 of demo slide
- `fallback_switch` at 00:10 if model errors
Priya: can we get a dry run Wed 10am PT? I'll send invites.
OpsBot: created rehearsal event — Wed 2025-04-16 10:00PT. RSVP here: https://cal.re/redwood/rehearsal
CalendarBot: Event created and invites sent to Elena, Samir, Jordan, Priya, stage_ops
Samir: adding a short checklist for panelists: mic check 10 min, run-through 20 min, bio + sticker slide 5 min.
Elena: perfect. Also let's have backup recording on and a clear postmortem channel (incidents) in case of content regressions.
Jordan: can we add a visible "next speaker" cue in lower-right corner? simple text overlay.
Priya: noted. I'll update the deck with overlay and two timer styles (countdown + progress bar).
Elena: deadlines: deck updates by Tue EOD, speaker notes by Wed 6am PT, full rehearsal Wed 10am PT. Ping me when done :rocket:
Samir: will do. :thumbsup:
Jordan: LGTM
Priya: thanks everyone :heart:
Elena: closing thread — will post final deck link after updates.
